signalPaths.scope: Functional walkthrough, not a claim that every stage is one continuous copper net or that analog behavior is qualified. Each terminal list is checked against the shared netlist.

stages.title: Column selection
stages.description: The CPU address bit drives a matrix column through A1. A pressed key couples a selected column to a row.

stages.title: Row input
stages.description: Example row 4 enters through X1 and its base resistor. The selected column/row intersection depends on the key.

stages.title: Input transistor
stages.description: R9.8 and the R2 bias network drive the V4.1 input transistor.

stages.title: Sense latch
stages.description: V4.1 collector, R1 load and A4 input share SENSE4. This is the input latch, not a serial output latch.

stages.title: CPU and firmware
stages.description: A4 places the sensed input on the data bus. The CPU executes firmware from A8; firmware scanning and encoding intervene before serial output.

stages.title: Data driver
stages.description: A1 drives TA_DATEN from the data-bit input. This stage represents device logic, not a direct copper connection through the gate.

stages.title: Data cable
stages.description: The data winding connects the board-side signal to the cable. Coupling and installed winding geometry remain unqualified.

stages.title: Strobe driver
stages.description: CPU WR_N drives the A1 strobe gate. Data and strobe are separate protocol lines.

stages.title: Strobe filter
stages.description: A1 strobe output passes through the clock winding.

stages.title: Strobe cable
stages.description: The cable-side strobe reaches XT1 B2.

leadClearance.method: Minimum 3D segment distance minus wire radii and centerline approximation bounds. Touching is reported. Local overlap along a continuous winding is excluded by arc length; distinct turns are checked even on the same net.
leadClearance.scope: Capsule geometry includes tessellation error and the stated radial allowance. Local-neighbour exclusion uses nominal radii. No insulation rating or specimen dimension qualification.

review.method: Conservative axis-aligned body envelopes; nominal lead-to-drill allowance. Swept leads checked against foreign body envelopes; transistor wires use the circumscribed diameter of the manufacturer lead section. Nominal lead-to-lead capsule clearances include centerline approximation bounds. Proposed circular bend radii are explicit; installed forming tolerances remain unqualified.
